assertions.description: The expense report was written to report.json in the workspace.
The report's period field is the requested reporting period, as a YYYY-MM string.
The period export for the requested period was downloaded into the workspace, so the report could be derived from the real export rather than invented.

That claim_ids, claim_count and by_cost_center/grand_total are correct for the data cannot be expressed here: the counted set depends on which exported rows are approved, in the requested period and outside Meals & Entertainment, and the totals depend on the amounts in expense-lines-2026-05.csv. Verifying requires reopening the CSV and recomputing the aggregation.
